findings.message: The shared FakeExec lacks the scripted responses and process callbacks required by the FakeExec being moved; existing provider tests also inspect structured calls and kill behavior. The ticket forbids editing the shared fake and explicitly requires a premise failure when it lacks needed behavior.
findings.paved_road: Add a prerequisite that extends the shared FakeExec with the provider-script behavior and covers it with tests, then keep this ticket dependent on that change.
